scope: Phase3 supporting-history trust review; not part of261 forward scorecard and not190 fresh execution/PASS claims

groups.name: process
groups.disposition: Historical rule/handoff/tracker controls and current rule equality reviewed; fresh tracker metadata cannot be reread while approval authentication is blocked. No new no-context helper run is claimed for this active checkpoint.

groups.name: watcher
groups.disposition: Retained failure/success/lifecycle controls plus actual completed current14/UI03 ownership establish recorder trust. Disconnected notification remains unconfigured#395; no future alert or background reasoning is inferred.

groups.name: cloud-fixtures
groups.disposition: Production compatibility and three actual installed backends checked in Phase2. Former failed stamps/keys/too-fast cuts remain historical failures; accepted scoped retries do not prove actual mid-copy SIGKILL or every negative mixed-pair clause.

groups.name: visual-custody
groups.disposition: Original frames and qualification manifests separately reviewed. Observer complete-frame controls, selected system and setup metadata distinguish present files from valid pixels. Earlier owners/counts/claims are not rewritten.

groups.name: identity-fixtures
groups.disposition: Source and installed current14 identity/license/export tested in Phase2. Earlier09 full artifact sweep remains09 evidence; current/repaired final image needs a fresh full sweep. Bootloader-specific proof checks actual GRUB, not an inactive syslinux file.

groups.name: proxy-continuity
groups.disposition: Intervening upstream pins retained as their own build history. Current exact879 source/native equality, cache preservation and real award/UI qualification govern; freshness is a timestamped upstream observation, not perpetual latest.

groups.name: settings-race
groups.disposition: Same installed ES process paused around actual shell writes; current source equality and fresh119assertions independently checked. Hook installation alone is not proof of interleaving.

groups.name: memory-help
groups.disposition: Help contract is host tooling only; actual loaded-page/RSS qualification belongs to I362-L71. No helper text is promoted to a runtime measurement.

groups.name: host-swap
groups.disposition: Prior isolated35-test review, later37-test policy controls and actual authorized rollout are distinct. Root-only policy digest is attributed to owner readback. No current swap or privileged recovery operation rerun.

groups.name: cleanup
groups.disposition: Historical exact authorized five-tree removal and preserved files/source/backing chains reviewed; original03/05 failures retained. Scope excludes new deletion, reserve change or a new full capacity inventory.
